claims.statement: An agent develops and examines a concrete prospective software increment and its proposed knowledge together without promoting candidate evidence or source to reviewed product truth.

attributes.title: Prospective source and knowledge co-design

alignment.basis: Reciprocal product and knowledge development under ADR 0038 with agent-owned authority.

ambition.basis: A distinct constructive activity joins actual prospective code/evidence changes with mechanically checked candidate knowledge.

horizon.basis: Recombines existing disposable rehearsal, definition comparison and single-pack stewardship.

realization.basis: At feature a175b9d9, actual run 46094915471 rehearsed all six paths of the complete #1011 candidate from c1f95ed5 to 44d2d695 with exact before/after digests, two additions and four modifications. Its new pack passed the single-pack preflight (2 claims, 3 relations, 3 existing endpoints), including the new supporting history file. The actual pack-only slice had the same proposal digest but returned NOT_VALIDATED because that evidence path was absent. The BASE review excluded the proposed capability, and default structural and reverse deletion patches were refused. Active checkout HEAD and cleanliness were preserved.

history.basis: Existing rehearsal refused additions and separate preflight required tracked candidate evidence. See preconstruction report at 7a12ff69.

disposition_history.authority: agent construction selection within delegated self-development
disposition_history.rationale: Select opt-in single-pack co-design rather than arbitrary structural patch support or another symbol trigger evaluator; preserve manual fallback.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Recombine disposable exact-source patch rehearsal, definition-level source comparison and single-pack semantic stewardship. A separate disposable index contains the explicit candidate's new evidence; BASE knowledge remains committed-only and the proposed pack is checked separately, never promoted.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A coding agent can rehearse the source change and proposed accompanying knowledge as one concrete intervention, mechanically checking the new pack against its actual candidate evidence while keeping the reviewed baseline separate.
attributes.revisit_when: A real candidate requires more than one pack or a structural change outside the admitted scope, or file:src/sensemaking_skills/patch_rehearsal.py changes, or later actual use makes the workflow redundant.
attributes.counterevidence: Manual isolated composition remains viable. One historical complete candidate and its pack-only slice do not establish comparative efficiency, independent selection or runtime behavior. Shared Git objects may remain; the worktree is not a security sandbox.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Observed bounded candidate co-design and evidence-dependent preflight; independent benefit, general structural support, semantic correctness and runtime effects remain unestablished.

claims.statement: A coding agent can rehearse the source change and proposed accompanying knowledge as one concrete intervention, mechanically checking the new pack against its actual candidate evidence while keeping the reviewed baseline separate.

value_frame.beneficiary: An agent deciding whether a concrete product increment and its proposed knowledge representation are ready for ordinary source review.
value_frame.criterion: Allow the real selected code-plus-knowledge construction to be examined together before active-checkout integration, preserving BASE authority and exact proposal evidence.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Existing structural refusal and manual disposable checkout plus single-pack preflight.
value_frame.expected_observation: Without opt-in the real #1011 full patch remains refused; with explicit one-new-pack opt-in, the real full patch from c1f95ed5 to 44d2d695 rehearses all six changed paths (four modifications, two additions), matches source digests, and the existing preflight checks the new pack against its actual candidate evidence including the new history file. An actual pack-only slice lacks that evidence and cannot receive a successful preflight.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: Scope/authority fails, the preflight conflates proposed and reviewed truth, or actual beneficiaries find the composition redundant.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: New code, processing and temporary Git objects are costs; manual composition remains viable. Same eight-file and 256 KiB budget; single new pack and contained regular-file additions only.

claims.statement: An agent rehearses revision of one existing reviewed knowledge pack and its actual supporting evidence/source changes with BASE knowledge retained and a separate candidate preflight.

attributes.title: Existing-pack source/knowledge co-design

alignment.basis: Supports durable correction and enrichment of product knowledge under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Extends existing co-design to the revision lifecycle.

horizon.basis: Existing single-pack steward supports revision and incoming relations.

realization.basis: Two actual intervention alternatives authored; scoped comparison pending.

disposition_history.rationale: Compare staged reuse and unstaged modification-only before selection.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Reuse the existing verified disposable staged overlay and single-pack steward for an explicit existing-pack revision; compare a narrower unstaged modification-only alternative on authentic patches.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A development agent can rehearse revision of an existing knowledge pack and new supporting source/evidence in one concrete intervention while preserving the BASE possibility and mechanically preflighting the candidate separately.
attributes.revisit_when: A real candidate requires multiple packs or file:src/sensemaking_skills/patch_rehearsal.py changes.
attributes.counterevidence: An unstaged modification-only overlay and manual isolated steward are viable when all evidence is already tracked. Added supporting evidence needs the guarded staged overlay; shared candidate Git objects may remain. No full-snapshot acceptance.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Source-authored candidate, comparison pending; no semantic correctness, runtime behavior, comparative cost or independent cognitive benefit.

claims.statement: A development agent can rehearse revision of an existing knowledge pack and new supporting source/evidence in one concrete intervention while preserving the BASE possibility and mechanically preflighting the candidate separately.

value_frame.beneficiary: Development agent revising existing knowledge in real sustained software construction.
value_frame.criterion: Both concrete alternatives rehearse actual #1018 revision; compare additional evidence paths on current full contribution and pack-only slice; preserve prior behavior and BASE context.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Manual disposable checkout plus single-pack steward; existing new-pack co-design refuses an existing selected pack.
value_frame.expected_observation: Staged and unstaged routes validate actual #1018; staged route alone admits real current added evidence and validates revised pack; pack-only slice lacks that evidence.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: Reconsider if staged scope or incoming-reference validation fails, candidate knowledge appears in BASE, default/new-pack behavior changes, or later work needs multiple packs.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: Staging may retain candidate objects; narrow unstaged approach avoids this at expense of new evidence support.

attributes.would_change_decision_if: Reconsider if staged scope or incoming-reference validation fails, candidate knowledge appears in BASE, default/new-pack behavior changes, or later work needs multiple packs.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Prospective discriminator committed before candidate implementation at 544db4b9.
